title: Bashful Bubble Bobtail
statement: A thumb-sized, lantern-bellied squid who collects stray bubbles in a tiny glass-bead net and hides behind a curtain of emerald ribbon-weed whenever someone looks too long, glowing a soft peach-pink as it blushes. Its tank is a moonlit teal twilight with a sunken teacup, a drift of pearly pebbles, and one slow shaft of light, all arranged to be a very small, very cozy place to be shy.
